annotations.title: Get Walt Disney World bus times

description: Use this when a visitor asks when the next Walt Disney World bus leaves a resort or stop for a park or Disney Springs. Pass a stop name or ID; without one, it lists the stops. Predictions come from Disney's own bus tracking.

stop.description: Bus stop ID or name; a resort name works, such as Art of Animation. Omit to list the stops.
